decisions.reason: Selecting Transak for the fiat on-ramp does not change the independently selected Brevo transactional email provider or delivery requirement.
The source changes the fiat on-ramp provider but does not change email-based dashboard authentication, its login flow, or its intended users.
The fiat on-ramp provider selection does not alter unauthenticated access to public referral statistics.
The source decision concerns only the fiat on-ramp provider and does not alter the badge set, icons, or presentation rules.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not change the commission or prize-ticket rewards for successful coded referrals.
The Transak selection does not change the random reward rule for mints made without a referral code.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not alter the Small Block or Big Block ticket counters exposed in NFT metadata.
Selecting Transak does not change random prize selection, winner eligibility, or ticket weighting.
The fiat on-ramp provider selection does not change the requirement to enforce royalties on secondary sales.
The source decision does not change the first-referral badge condition or any badge-award rule.
